Figure 72, you will be shown a video, here the video will play automatically. To 
view the video controls, you must press the screen. From here going from left to 
right along the middle of the screen, you can restart the video, go back 5 
seconds, play/pause, jump forward 5 seconds. 
At the bottom of the page, you can drag your progress through the lesson by 
pulling on the circular progress indicator. To change the videos playback speed 
simply press the cog and change the settings from there. 
If the video is displaying a swirling circle, then that means the video is currently 
buffering to a playable state. You can see the progress of the buffer by looking 
at the progress bar, the lightest region indicates what you have viewed so far, 
and the slightly darker region is the buffer zone. 
Once you have finished the video you may progress through the lesson by 
pressing the continue button.
